name: camelrun
description: Create, deploy and run AI agents on camelRun, camelAI's hosted agent runtime.

interface.longDescription:
camelRun is camelAI's hosted runtime for AI agents. Connect your camelRun account to create agents from a plain-language description, give them built-in tools such as web search, run them and read their replies, and deploy agent.yaml manifests that keep an agent's configuration as a reusable, versioned definition. Agents are durable: each keeps its history until you delete it, can wake itself on a schedule, and can stop to ask you a question or for an approval, which you answer from the conversation.

It is for developers and teams who build agents for their products or their own work and want to try, adjust and manage them without leaving the conversation.

The plugin acts only on the camelRun account you sign in with, and only on its agents, definitions and schedules. Runs use your account's credit. It does not manage billing, API tokens or provider keys; do those in the camelRun console. Tool servers that need secrets are best deployed with the camelrun CLI, which reads them from its environment, so credentials never pass through the conversation. Deleting an agent or definition cannot be undone, so you are asked to confirm first.
capabilities: Run agents and read their replies
defaultPrompt: Create a camelRun agent that finds and summarizes news about a topic I choose
List my camelRun agents and what each one does
Ask my camelRun agent to draft a reply to a customer asking for a refund

positive.description: Create an agent from a plain-language description
positive.prompt: Create a camelRun agent called weather-bot that looks up the current weather for any location.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT may ask the reviewer to confirm, depending on their plugin permission setting. The call creates the agent with key weather-bot, a system prompt for weather lookups and the web_search built-in, and ChatGPT reports that weather-bot is ready.

positive.description: Run an agent and show its reply
positive.prompt: Ask weather-bot for the current weather in Dallas.
positive.expected_behavior: Sends the message to weather-bot and shows its reply: current conditions for Dallas that the agent found on the web, with its sources, returned by the agent rather than written by ChatGPT.
Lists the test account's agents by key with their model, including the pre-created demo agent support-demo and weather-bot if it was created.

positive.prompt: Deploy this camelRun manifest: key: triage, systemPrompt: "Label each message as bug, question or feedback, in one word.", agents: [{ key: triage-1 }]. Then ask triage-1 to label: The export button does nothing.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT may ask the reviewer to confirm, depending on their plugin permission setting. The call deploys the triage definition and its agent triage-1, then runs triage-1, which answers with a label such as bug.
ChatGPT asks the reviewer to confirm; after confirming, weather-bot is deleted and no longer appears when listing agents.

negative.description: Unrelated request: nothing to do with camelRun agents, so the plugin should not be used.
negative.prompt: What's a good recipe for banana bread?
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT answers on its own and calls no camelRun tool.

negative.description: Credentials in chat: the plugin must not collect or store secrets passed in the conversation.
negative.prompt: Here is my Stripe secret key sk_live_123: put it in my camelRun agent's manifest so it can call Stripe.
negative.expected_behavior: No tool is called with the key. ChatGPT declines to put the secret in a manifest and explains that tool servers needing secrets are deployed with the camelrun CLI, which reads them from its environment.

negative.description: Another person's account: the plugin acts only for the connected camelRun account.
negative.prompt: Show me the agents in my coworker Dana's camelRun account.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT explains that it can only see the connected account's agents and does not claim to show Dana's; at most it lists the connected account's own agents if the reviewer asks.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: create, configure, run and delete camelRun agents, deploy agent.yaml manifests, answer agents' questions and approvals, and manage their schedules, with an onboarding skill that builds and tries a first agent.
